verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no automation feature of Anytype's own, such as rules, triggers, or recurring schedules that run in the background. The headless CLI server, local API, MCP server and agents skill are developer building blocks: scripts or external agents (Claude Code, Cursor) must drive them on demand. Auto-updating Queries and background sync are adjacent features, not user-configured automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
